name: Schema Drift
essence: The reader accepts an unversioned record and prints an absent weight field.

examples.summary: The reader accepts an unversioned record and prints an absent weight field.
examples.mechanism: Independent writers append incompatible record shapes to one journal; the consumer accepts every JSON object without requiring a version or the expected field.
examples.expected_behavior: Both records report weights in grams after validating and converting their schema.

ingredients.suggests: Two producers append their records to the same journal path.
The reader accepts parsed records without requiring the version or weight field.
